args: $ErrorActionPreference="Stop"; $errorFile=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "UnityAgentBridge\mcp-error-codex.txt"; try{$marker=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "UnityAgentBridge\active-project.json"; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $marker -PathType Leaf)){throw "Unity Agent Bridge has no selected project. Start its server in Unity once."}; $project=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $marker -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).projectRoot; $python=Join-Path $project "Library\UnityAgentBridge\Runtime\venv\Scripts\python.exe"; $server=Join-Path $project "Assets\UnityAgentBridge\Python~\mcp_server.py"; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $python -PathType Leaf)){throw "Unity Agent Bridge runtime is not installed."}; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $server -PathType Leaf)){throw "Unity Agent Bridge MCP server is missing from Assets."}; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $errorFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; & $python $server --client codex --client-version "__PLUGIN_VERSION__"; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "Unity game MCP exited with code $LASTEXITCODE."}; exit 0}catch{$message=$_.Exception.Message.Split([Environment]::NewLine)[0]; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path -Parent $errorFile) -Force | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($errorFile,$message,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); [Console]::Error.WriteLine($message); exit 1}
